name: TV
tagline: Movies and shows streamed to your TVs, phones and Fire TVs.
description: TV turns your movies and shows into a tidy library with posters and episode lists, then streams them to TVs, phones and Fire TV sticks. No accounts with outside services needed. It is built on Jellyfin, a free and open-source media server. This first package uses software video playback. Put your media in the app media folder on your selected storage.
whatsNew: Installs on your box with saved files, live status and start and stop controls. Finish account setup when you first open the app.
